### Clarify (react)

Multi-turn ReAct dialogue to turn vague requirements into a **structured requirement**.

**Mandatory deliverable**: call `set_clarified_requirement` to write `clarified_requirement.json`. Node fails if missing.

**Questions**: use `ask_question` with optional `recommended` options (at most one for single-select; one or more for multi-select). Unmarked falls back to the first option in auto mode.

**Auto-clarify**: when auto variable is true, platform auto-selects recommended options each round until done or max rounds.

**Auto artifact**: only the reserved JSON `clarified_requirement.json` is auto-written; it can be shown structurally and gated with `exists("clarified_requirement.json")` / `json("clarified_requirement.json").field`.

**Conditional injection**: append extra prompt when a configured global variable exists (e.g. after gate backfill).

preflight.help:
### Preflight

Check **execution environment** needed by later implement/test steps against upstream plan, repo, and vars.

**Mandatory deliverable**: call `set_preflight` to write `preflight.json` (summary, confirmed=true; fields may be empty for no-gap; passwords plaintext). Missing or incomplete checklist blocks finish.

**Gaps**: finite options via `ask_question`; free text via `ask_form` (type text|url only; passwords as plaintext text). Forms show human labels only; hover explains the plan gap. Form submit enters the dialogue and **does not** replace set_preflight.

**No gaps**: write confirmed with empty fields, then `node_complete` — no inbox wait.

**No 「Confirm & continue」** on this node; the agent calls `node_complete` after the gate passes. Confirmed fields are exported as plaintext run vars; SandboxEnv is unchanged.

submit_mr.help:
### Submit MR (submit_mr)

Supports merge requests (MR/PR). Configure `GITLAB_URL` / `GITHUB_URL` to match the repository host (also recognizes gitlab.com / github.com).

Agent node in the sandbox; run these four steps:

1. **Resolve conflicts**: merge the target branch into the source (`git fetch` + merge/rebase); resolve conflicts and commit.
2. **Push**: `git push` the source branch (host-agnostic).
3. **Create/reuse the merge request**: route by remote host — GitLab (gitlab.com or host matching `GITLAB_URL`) via `glab`; GitHub (github.com or host matching `GITHUB_URL`, including GHE) via `gh pr`; unmatched hosts (e.g. Gitea) do not support automatic MR/PR creation. Order: list open → create → parse idempotent errors (`already exists` / `No commits between`) → list merged/view. Reuse an open URL and skip create when present; treat already-merged-with-no-new-commits and synced-with-no-history as idempotent success (empty `mr_url` allowed). A non-zero create exit must not fail the node by itself.
4. **Mark complete**: call `node_complete` (on success prefer `outputs.mr_url` as the open/merged Web URL; GitHub PR URLs use the same field. Idempotent success may leave `mr_url` empty).

**Credentials & CLI**: `GITLAB_*` / `GITHUB_*`; preinstall `glab` (GitLab) or `gh` (GitHub). If the CLI is missing, the host cannot auto-create, or a true failure occurs (push/auth/unresolved conflicts): **still finish conflict resolution and push** when possible, then `node_complete(status=failed)`. The failure summary/error must state that conflicts were resolved and the source branch was pushed, plus the create/CLI/host reason. Closed-but-unmerged with no new commits is also failed. Do **not** treat “push succeeded” as success with an empty `mr_url` (except the idempotent success paths above).

**Dual-path capability gap**: the Agent path may route glab/gh by host; platform auto-create (`detect_push`/`create_mr`) remains **GitLab-only** in this iteration — GitHub depends on Agent-side `gh`; the platform will not create PRs for you.

The platform does **not** verify push/MR/conflicts via git/glab/gh. Default checks only require `node_complete`; optional business RPC runs only after default checks pass.

**Target repo modes**:
- **Empty**: legacy default — Agent-guided multi-repo / lone-repo fallback.
- **`{'{{vars.repos}}'}`**: engine iterates the runtime `vars.repos` list in order (fail-fast; no subset multi-select). Distinct from empty.
- **Literal name / single-name string var** (e.g. `web` or `{'{{vars.target_repo}}'}`): strict interpolate, must be ∈ `vars.repos`.

**Branches**: literal or single-branch string var; when set, shared across all repos in list mode. Empty source uses per-repo defaults (`vars.branches[name]` / `repo.branch`). Do **not** put the whole `{'{{vars.branches}}'}` map as the source branch value.

**Auth from sandbox**: use sandbox `git` and the matching CLI (`glab`/`gh`); no external platform token setup.

**Output**: `mr_url` → global `vars.mr_url` (last repo wins after a full list success).

human_gate.help:
### Human gate (human_gate)

Suspends at the orchestrator and appears in the **Pending approvals** inbox. Review content and **Confirm & continue**. The same approval UI can also open from run detail.

**Difference vs app preview**: human gate enters the inbox as a Gate; app preview enters Pending approvals as preview review (badge 「App Preview」) and can still be handled from the run-detail review tab. Both end with Confirm & continue — **no Approve / Send-back dual buttons**. When an approval session is available, keep picking/chatting to revise in place; confirm only when satisfied.

**Display content / primary whitelist**

- `body_template` controls which primary artifacts appear in the gate editor
- Reference with `{'{{nodes.*.outputs.*}}'}` or `artifact("name")`
- **Any artifact humans must edit must be listed in body_template**; produces-only names are not editable
- Non-text primaries (e.g. images) show as read-only tabs and cannot be saved

**Config-layer actions (compat)**

- Config may keep actions / when edges (including legacy fail/revise); the standard review UI only resumes on a positive action (approve/pass) and **does not** restore send-back buttons for compat
- Canvas footnote: 「Confirm & continue · inbox」; subtitle 「Human approval」

**Output variable**

- Confirm writes the positive action id (default `action`) for downstream nodes and branches

app_preview.help:
### App preview (app_preview)

Agent builds/starts the app in sandbox or registers a deployed external URL via `set_preview(port?, url?, label?)` (exactly one of port or url). After at least one successful registration the node enters preview review (**no Gate**). External http(s) URLs (port allowed) open in a browser iframe directly with no server-side probe; pick-annotate may be degraded. While waiting for human confirm it appears in the **Pending approvals** inbox (badge 「App Preview」) and can also be handled from the run-detail review tab: both support pick annotate → add to chat, and in-place edits when an approval session is available, then Confirm & continue on a single success exit; finishing either side clears both pending surfaces.

**Direct IP preview** (node switch `direct_preview`, default off): on uses a port-direct iframe, off uses noVNC. Both load through the preview proxy, which injects the pick script. **Auto-inject** (`auto_inject`, default on): the sandbox inserts `$PREVIEW_PICK_SCRIPT_URL` into inbound HTML so pick-annotate works without editing the app; turn off to add the script tag yourself. Off for direct preview keeps the existing noVNC pick flow.

**Same interaction as human gate**: both use pick + chat + Confirm & continue; both appear in Pending approvals with distinct badges. Missing Approve/Reject is not a bug — Confirm & continue is the end action.

**The app must listen on `0.0.0.0:<port>`** (not just 127.0.0.1): the preview is reverse-proxied via the container's bridge IP, so a loopback-only bind is unreachable and the preview goes blank (502).

Canvas footnote: 「Confirm & continue · inbox」; subtitle 「Pick annotate · Await confirmation」. Legacy pass/fail edges are silently compatible (confirm injects action=pass).

grasp.help:
### Grasp

One multi-turn ReAct dialogue for **pre-dev work**. This node configures an Agent, a timeout (default 30 minutes), **direct IP preview** (`direct_preview`, default off), and **auto-inject** (`auto_inject`, default on): **no prompt template**, **no round cap**, and no auto-clarify / conditional injection. With direct preview off, `set_preview` uses noVNC; with it on, a port-direct iframe. Both load through the preview proxy, which injects the pick script, so the app source stays unchanged. The platform injects run inputs and waits for the user to state the goal first; the agent then uses tools to align requirements and only `ask_question` when there is a real decision.

**Two mandatory deliverables** (both required to finish — not a single unique delivery):
1. `set_clarified_requirement` → `clarified_requirement.json` (`open_questions` must be empty; includes `work_kind`)
2. `set_plan` → `plan.json` (at most two levels: goal → sub-goal; when writing the design zone, include all six sections or explicit 不涉及, optional Mermaid diagrams)

**Bug-only extra deliverable**: when `work_kind` is `bug`, `set_root_cause` → `root_cause.json` (structured JSON, **not** `page.html` or generic `write_artifact`); non-bug runs must not keep this artifact.

**Optional** (shown if present, missing does not fail): `set_research`; `set_proposals` (**only when ≥2 distinct alternatives need a user pick**; no single-candidate pseudo-choice); `write_artifact` for `page.html`; `set_preview` to register a running app (sandbox port or external url — not a completion condition, does not end this node).

If a skill pack says “unique delivery” or forbids those tools, **platform rule `rules/grasp.md` wins**. Do not write implementation code or change the repo.
